name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 5 visits over 29 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 27 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 29 hours starting 2025-05-06, at wavelengths from 1.03 to 4.41 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
